title: My Husband is Annoying – B1+ English Listening Test

seo.title: My Husband is Annoying – B1+ English Listening Test - Test-English
seo.description: B1-B2 listening test. Advanced listening practice. Relationships. Transcription included. Watch the video and answer the questions.

parts:
B1+ English Listening Test

Watch a video about a blog where a wife talks about annoying things her husband does. For questions 1 to 7, choose the correct option.

See the full list of B1+ listening tests
Questions

questions.prompt: When Tiffanie’s husband saw the blog for the first time ...

choices.html: he thought it was funny
he didn’t really like it, which made his wife laugh
he hated the picture of him asleep

questions.prompt: About the Irish accent, the couple says that ...

choices.html: he did it when they went to Ireland.
he wants to do it when they go to Ireland.
he has an Irish accent because his family is from Dublin.
she thought a lot of people could potentially read it.
she just wanted to have fun.
she wanted to know if other women also had annoying husbands.
has had lots of visits over the last three weeks.
has existed for two weeks.
has had lots of visits over the last week.

questions.prompt: A lot of women who post comments on the blog say that ...

choices.html: they are sorry for Tiffanie
their husband is very physically similar to Tiffanie’s husband
their husband is annoying too

questions.prompt: One of the things that annoys her is that ...

choices.html: he always wants to be photographed with a beer
he doesn’t take photos of her as much as she takes pictures of him
he drinks too much beer
Tiffanie’s husband started writing about his annoying wife
many people have published posts and photos about their wives
a reader of Tiffanie’s blog started a blog about their annoying wife
